finding.text: The fix matches all three asks in requirements.md and lands only in `ux/Dictate/Dictate.js` + `doc/decisions.md`, as scoped; `git show` on `worktree/dictate-android` (commit `625a3ee3`) confirms it is actually committed, not just a loose patch file.

`shots/before-demo-400.png` and `shots/after-demo-400.png` are real proof, not a claim: before shows the exact repeated-sentence bug ("so so tell so tell me…") and the "aborted" error line; after shows the clean sentence and no error, with the mic still listening.

`browser_error`'s "No speech was heard — try again, closer to the microphone" message (Dictate.js:713 pre-patch numbering) is now effectively dead in the normal flow, since `no-speech` only reaches it when `this.stopping` is true — i.e. only on a press-to-stop, where showing a "no speech" alarm would be confusing. This was already the behavior before this patch (every error used to reach `browser_error` unconditionally), so it's not a regression this fix introduced, but it's a loose end worth a future look.

report.md honestly flags two pre-existing issues it did not fix (the engine label running past the edge at 400px, and a `cardRows.filter is not a function` console error on every page) — both visible in the before shot too, so they are not caused by this change.
